title: feat(core): resolveRequestExecutionContext, the one request-to-ExecutionContext composition; the runtime dispatcher's door calls it
body:
Part of #23217

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Ruling-ref: 6227928430

Slice 1 of #23217 under ruling record 6227928430 (letter A): the one request-to-ExecutionContext function in `@objectstack/core`, plus the runtime dispatcher's own door. #23217 remains open for the other four doors (`rest-server.ts`, `service-settings`, `service-storage`, `plugin-hono-server`), each a later slice with `Clause-②: no`. No door's outward behaviour changes, and there is no app-author surface.

## What changed

- **`@objectstack/core`**: new `packages/core/src/security/request-execution-context.ts` with `resolveRequestExecutionContext`, exported from core's `.` entry through `security/index.ts`, beside `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture`. Its docblock states the two choices (the anonymous entry, the ADR-0069 gate) and every named parameter with the door that needs it.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**: `resolveExecutionContext` (`packages/runtime/src/security/resolve-execution-context.ts`) keeps what is its own (the service lookups, the header normalisation, the `/mcp` OAuth verification and scope interpretation) and hands the rest to the function. 209 lines out, 87 in.
- **Ruling item 4**: `packages/runtime/src/security/request-execution-context.conformance.test.ts`, one row per converted door.
- **Unit tests**: `packages/core/src/security/request-execution-context.test.ts`, 20 cases, one battery per choice and per parameter, each reading paired with its control.
- **Two files outside the claim's surface, both forced by the move** (named for the seat to declare):
  - `packages/core/src/security/authz-store-unavailable.test.ts`: its transport ledger is set-equal to the files that call `resolveAuthzContext({`. That call moved from the runtime door into the new core module, which is ledgered `propagates`.
  - `scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs`: check (2) required the runtime door to contain `resolveAuthzContext`, and after the move only its docblock prose would have satisfied that. `DELEGATORS` now names each delegator's call: rest and the new core module call `resolveAuthzContext`, and the runtime door calls `resolveRequestExecutionContext`. The self-test drives the non-delegating case for every row.
- **Changeset**: `minor` on `@objectstack/core`. Runtime has none: no byte a reader sees moves.

## The exported signature (for the seat's review of the new export)

This is verbatim except for one change: `‹` and `›` stand for the angle brackets, because the body sanitizer strips tag-shaped fragments. The byte-exact text is `packages/core/src/security/request-execution-context.ts` lines 84-166 and 214-221 at `f5a955e12`.

```ts
export type RequestAuthService = Pick‹
  IAuthService,
  'api' | 'getApi' | 'isAuthGateActive' | 'resolveUserAuthGates' | 'resolveApiKeyLifecyclePolicy'
›;

export interface EstablishedRequestSession {
  user: { id: string };
  session: { userId: string; activeOrganizationId?: string };
}

export interface RequestAdmission {
  credential: 'api_key' | 'session';
  authGate: AuthGate | undefined;
}

export interface RequestExecutionContextInput {
  headers: Headers;
  ql: unknown;
  authService: RequestAuthService | undefined;
  tenancy: TenancyServiceResolver | undefined;
  anonymous: 'fail-closed' | 'guest';
  authGate: 'withhold' | 'resolved' | 'reread-when-active';
  credentials: 'api-key-and-session' | 'session-only';
  sessionApi: 'optional' | 'required';
  session: 'request' | 'none' | { readonly established: EstablishedRequestSession };
  localization: 'withhold' | { readonly settings: () => unknown };
  requestLocale: string | undefined;
  accessToken: 'carry' | 'withhold';
  oauth: OAuthTokenProvenance | undefined;
  onAdmission: ((admission: RequestAdmission) => void) | undefined;
}

export function resolveRequestExecutionContext(
  input: RequestExecutionContextInput & { anonymous: 'guest' },
): Promise‹ExecutionContext›;
export function resolveRequestExecutionContext(
  input: RequestExecutionContextInput,
): Promise‹ExecutionContext | undefined›;
```

Every key is required, as on `ExecutionContextAssemblyInput`: a door with no value passes `undefined` or the withholding literal, so no door can drop an input by leaving it out. The function catches nothing around the resolver. An unreadable permission store, tenancy service or active-gate re-read (`AuthzStoreUnavailableError`, 503), and an API key its own lifecycle refuses (`ApiKeyLifecycleRefusalError`, 403), reach the door's own net.

Two notes on the name, for the seat. A runtime-internal helper of the same name was deleted in the GraphQL retirement (`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`, "the now-dead `resolveRequestExecutionContext` helper removed"). It was never exported, and this export is unrelated. The ruling's other name candidates are open if the seat prefers one.

## H1: the door differences, counted before slice 1 was written (`origin/main` `7be3cc728`)

Every door was read one step at a time: the session read, the ADR-0069 gate, `resolveAuthzContext`, the posture classification, the anonymous entry, and any extra fields.

| # | step | rest `rest-server.ts` `computeExecCtx` | runtime `resolve-execution-context.ts` | settings `settings-service-plugin.ts` `verifiedContextFromRequest` | storage `storage-service-plugin.ts` `buildFileReadAuthorizer` + `buildAuthGateSessionReader` | hono `current-user-endpoints.ts` `makeExecutionContextResolver` | named parameter |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | anonymous entry | fail-closed (no context, 401) | guest envelope + guest anchor grants | fail-closed (`{ enforced: true }`) | fail-closed (`'unauthenticated'`) | fail-closed (no context) | `anonymous` |
| 2 | ADR-0069 gate | key: the admission's posture; session: re-read only while `isAuthGateActive()`, a failed re-read is 503 | withheld (the dispatcher's `enforceAuthGate` reads the session; a key's answer leaves through `onAdmission`) | `authz.authGate` from the admitting read, no re-read | its own gate reader: active check, key arm, session re-read, a failed re-read is 503 | withheld (`/me` routes are allow-listed for a gated user) | `authGate` |
| 3 | credential doors | API key + session | API key + session | API key + session | API key + session | session only (`headers: undefined` to the resolver) | `credentials` |
| 4 | no session API | no context (the key is not honoured) | resolves (the key is honoured) | resolves | no auth service means no authorizer (door-level); otherwise resolves | no context | `sessionApi` |
| 5 | session source | the auth service's in-process read | the same; on `/mcp`, a verified token's session, or none for an unverifiable JWT | the same | the same | the same (it drops a session with no `user.id`) | `session` |
| 6 | tenancy posture | kernel `getServiceAsync`, or the provider | the lookup thunk | kernel `getServiceAsync` when present | registry `getServiceAsync` when present | none (the session's claim stands) | `tenancy` (the resolution stays at the door, as #16013 left it) |
| 7 | admission channel | none | `onAdmission` | none | none | none | `onAdmission` |
| 8 | localization | settings provider | settings lookup | none (no envelope) | none (no envelope) | withheld (the endpoint reads the cascade) | `localization` |
| 9 | request locale | header or `?locale` (`metaRequestLocale`) | `Accept-Language` | none | none | none | `requestLocale` |
| 10 | session bearer | withheld | carried | none | carried (the raw envelope) | withheld | `accessToken` |
| 11 | OAuth provenance | none | `/mcp` only | none | none | none | `oauth` |

**Count: 11 differences, and every one is a named parameter. Zero doors need the item-5 fallback, so the premise holds.**

The remaining differences are door-side. They are not the composition, they stay at each door, and none of them is a copy:

- How a door turns its transport's headers into a Web `Headers`. The function takes a `Headers`.
- How a door reaches its services.
- How a door answers a fault. The function propagates every fault.
- What a door adds after assembly: rest adds `__kernel`, `__authEnvironmentId`, the per-request memo and the perf disclosure; hono adds the perf disclosure.
- What a door does with the envelope: settings projects it to `SettingsContext`, and storage hands it to `engine.find` as `context`.

## H2: the OAuth arm

The arm is split, measured as follows:

- **Stays at the door, ahead of the call.** Verification, and reading the scopes in the AI vocabulary (`scopesToAgentPermissionSets`, `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_ACTIONS`). Both need `@objectstack/spec/ai`, which core deliberately does not depend on (see the `OAuthTokenProvenance` docblock in `assemble-execution-context.ts`).
- **Enters the function as two named parameters.** `session` (`{ established }` for a verified token, `'none'` for an unverifiable JWT bearer) and `oauth`.

#24137's pins, `resolve-execution-context.oauth-organization.test.ts`, are green and unchanged (15 of 15).

## H3: the published surface

- Core's `.` entry reaches the new export through `export * from './security/index.js'` (`packages/core/src/index.ts:68`).
- No export census lists core's names. `classifyAdmissionTenancyPosture` appears nowhere outside `src/`: 0 hits in `scripts/` and in package JSON files.
- The published-surface gates the derivation named are in the gates section below.

## H4: dependency direction

The new module imports:

- core-internal modules;
- `@objectstack/spec/kernel` and `@objectstack/spec/contracts`, types only;
- `@objectstack/types` (`inProcessSessionReadInput`).

Both packages are already core dependencies, so no dependency was added. Nothing in the module imports runtime, rest or a plugin.

## Ruling item 4: the conformance test

Each converted door is a row. A row gives the door's own entry and the named parameters it declares. Every request is driven through both the door and the function, and the two contexts must be equal. A principal must also be the same principal at every door. The five requests were chosen so that each parameter changes at least one answer: no credential; a gated session user with a bearer and `Accept-Language`; an API key; an ex-member's key under a walled posture; and an API key on a host with no auth service. A CONTROL case shows that the fixture tells the runtime door's parameters apart. Slice 2 adds its door as one more row.

## Tests (HEAD `f5a955e12`, after merging `origin/main` `af284b05e`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run --project local`: 104 files, 2551 tests passed.
- The edited repo-project ledger, `vitest run --project repo src/security/authz-store-unavailable.test.ts`: 40 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local`: 413 files, 6318 passed and 19 skipped (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- The door pins and the dispatcher pins that drive the door, with the verbose reporter, at `7667d9b4d` before the merge (the post-merge full suite above includes them): 7 files, 111 tests passed. These are `resolve-execution-context.test.ts` (39), `resolve-execution-context.oauth-organization.test.ts` (15), the conformance test (7), `http-dispatcher.mcp-oauth`, `http-dispatcher.tenancy-posture-outage`, `http-dispatcher.keys` and `in-process-session-renewal.pin`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` both exit 0. The test layers are held at their ledgers: core 4 files and 4 errors, runtime 27 files and 190 errors, unchanged.

**Ablation of choice 1** (at `7667d9b4d`). Declared direction: red. The mutation makes the function always take the fail-closed entry: `return assembleExecutionContext(assembly); // ABLATION-23217-anonymous-entry`.

- **Landing.** Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0, marker 0 to 1, blob `e3a17add` to `86ec4e1f`.
- **No dist step.** Runtime's vitest aliases `@objectstack/core` to `../core/src/index.ts`, so no `dist/` step applies.
- **Result.** Core: 1 failed and 19 passed. The failing case is the guest-envelope case of choice 1. Runtime: 10 failed and 36 passed. Nine are door pins, among them "a sessionless request still yields the WHOLE guest envelope" and the tenancy "POSITIVE CONTROL". The tenth is the conformance CONTROL.
- **Restore.** The blob is `e3a17add` again, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Reading.** The conformance equalities themselves stay green under this ablation, by construction: both sides go through the one function. The CONTROL case and the unit battery are what catch a defect in the function.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `f5a955e12` derived 84 commands. Results follow in the os-dev-report.

The lane blind spot, `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 7 changed `.ts`/`.mjs` files, exits 0 with no output. `node scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs --self-test` and the gate itself both exit 0 ("all 3 entry points delegate").

## Acceptance notes

- **Runtime door, one ordering difference no production lookup reaches.** The door now looks up `auth` once, at the top. It used to look it up three times: two lookups absorbed their faults, and the gate-source lookup, which ran after the tenancy read, did not absorb a synchronous throw. Every answer is the same for a lookup that resolves or rejects. The answers differ only when the `auth` lookup throws synchronously and a tenancy service that failed to build is also present: the synchronous error now wins over the 503. The dispatcher's lookup (`resolveService`) never throws.
- **The card's text.** #23217's title ("not a published export") and its scope item 3 ("No new published export") still read as ruling C′ wrote them. Letter A amended item 1 to an export from core's `.` entry. That is a text fix for the seat, not a code question.
- **Storage (slice 4).** Storage hands the raw `ResolvedAuthzContext` to `engine.find` as `context`. The function's envelope adds `isSystem: false` and `principalKind: 'human'` and drops `credential`. Measured: no objectql, plugin-security or plugin-sharing source reads `context.credential`, and `principalKind` is read for `'guest'` only (`explain-engine.ts:149`). Slice 4's pins decide whether the envelope may be passed instead.
- **Hono (slice 5).** Hono's session read drops a session that has no `user.id`. The resolver reads `user.id ?? session.userId`, and no better-auth read answers without `user.id`. Slice 5 measures this.

## Handover for slice 2 (rest)

- **The call.** Convert `computeExecCtx` to call the function with `anonymous: 'fail-closed'`, `authGate: 'reread-when-active'`, `credentials: 'api-key-and-session'`, `sessionApi: 'required'`, `session: 'request'`, `localization: { settings: () => provider ? seamOrUndefined(() => provider(env)) : undefined }`, `requestLocale: this.extractLocale(req)`, `accessToken: 'withhold'`, `oauth: undefined` and `onAdmission: undefined`.
- **The tenancy thunk.** It stays rest's own: the kernel-or-provider branch.
- **Kept at the door.** The `if (!authService) return undefined` lookup, the header normalisation, `__kernel`, `__authEnvironmentId`, the memo, the perf disclosure, and the `catch` with its lifecycle-refusal side channel.
- **Then.** Move `DELEGATORS`' rest row to `resolveRequestExecutionContext`, add rest as a conformance row (runtime already depends on `@objectstack/rest`), and pin ADR-0096 and ADR-0069 per the ruling.
